transitions: read only after consent/credential policy ready
lease acquired and immutable request key reserved
provider acknowledgement only, not final business success
same provider request key status query confirms
no authoritative status lookup; human review, no blind retry
validation rejected; create corrected new draft revision
authorization revoked or definitive business rejection before sending
retry limit exhausted with definitively unaccepted outcome
final result not authoritative; status reconciliation required
authoritative completed result discovered by status query
compensation result ambiguous; never repeat blindly
provider definitively denies compensation; original external effect remains

auth.credentialStorage: external secret manager reference only; no secret in SQL/log/JSON
auth.rotation: pause jobs → verify new secret version with read capability → atomic reference switch → revoke old version; unknown in-flight requests retain original request identity
auth.expired: NEEDS_AUTH; no silent zero rows/no write retries
auth.capabilities: read and write separate credential scopes; write permission does not follow from read connection

idempotency.responseLost: same key status lookup before deciding next action
idempotency.retention: dedup retention must cover provider replay/correction horizon; duration requires provider and policy signoff
idempotency.sourceRevision: immutable normalized revision hash; numeric decimal strings; timezone and source timestamps preserved

read_incremental.timezone: Asia/Seoul business date; retain source timezone
read_incremental.pageCheckpoint: persist only after page staging validation; publish after full run reconciliation

read_and_outbox.writeSchedule: event-driven approved outbox only; no periodic issuance

outbox_only.afterCeiling: needs_review, keep unknown; provider actual processing SLA overrides proposal

reference_daily.interval: once per published business day plus documented correction pass

retry.retryAfter: respect provider Retry-After; do not exceed quota
retry.circuitBreaker: proposal: 5 connection failures in 10 minutes → pause 15 minutes; operational confirmation required

webhooks.authenticate: provider-specific signature over raw body; secret reference; timestamp/replay window per provider
webhooks.noEventId: validated canonical-event hash only after collision review
webhooks.ack: durable safe event journal first, then ack; raw PII payload not retained under current policy
webhooks.ordering: provider sequence/revision guards; older events retained but cannot downgrade current state
webhooks.verification: callbacks alone do not bypass authoritative reconciliation

audit.readAudit: start/end/error and dataset scope/count/hash; no row values
audit.access: append-only role, separate reader; audit deletion denied to worker; tamper-evidence/retention policy to approve

recovery.local: immutable import versions + active pointer revision CAS; preserve failed/reverted runs and audits
recovery.external: no DB rollback can undo issuance/transfer/delivery; separate supported compensation + approval + authoritative reconciliation
recovery.checkpoint: run/page cursor + input filters + schemaVersion + source revision; restart never advances incomplete page
recovery.publish: staged run → completeness/reconciliation checks → atomic pointer activation; absence in partial feed is not deletion
recovery.backup: proposed RPO24h/RTO4h for isolated metadata; approval required; external receipt journal must be durable before acknowledgement
drill: reconcile unknown external requests by read-only query before re-enabling writes
recovery.retention: TBD by policy, provider and statutory obligations; no asserted legal retention duration

common.cancellationBranch: 취소/정정은 원요청과 다른 requestKey의 연결된 요청이다. compensation failed/unknown은 원거래 성공을 덮어쓰지 않는다.

proposedStorage.purpose: allowlisted safe fields, immutable versions; private fields blocked
current revision CAS, tombstone only on explicit verified event
immutable request intent, approval refs, lease, attempt and transport state; no raw secret
safe callback/status query results with ordering evidence
